name: checkbox
useFor: Use for independent on or off choices that apply when a form is submitted (event subscriptions, consent). Pair each checkbox with a Label 8px to its right. Use the indeterminate state for a parent that covers some of its children. For a setting that applies at once use Switch.
constraints: A square glyph or a glyph other than Phosphor's circles
A checkbox that acts immediately like a switch
source: The Inkbox console's round Checkbox (18px circle, brand purple), drawn with Phosphor Circle, CheckCircle (fill) and MinusCircle (fill), as the user asked on 2026-11-04
title: Checkbox
description: Always a circle, drawn with Phosphor's circle glyphs on Chakra's checkbox: an empty circle when off, the filled brand-purple check circle when on and the filled minus circle when some are on.
